`qrcodegen.js` is Project Nayuki's MIT-licensed browser QR encoder, bundled
locally so conversation QRs work without a CDN or build/install step.

Source: https://www.nayuki.io/res/qr-code-generator-library/qrcodegen.js
Project: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
The upstream copyright and license are retained in the file.
